scope: Two production generation nodes only; not a company full-run replay or statistical evaluation
mandate: Assess a seed software investment strictly from admitted historical evidence. The package README proves only an SDK and documentation links. It supplies no revenue, retention, customer, team or market-size evidence. Treat those gaps as unknown and request decision-changing diligence. Do not use model memory or infer missingness as adverse evidence.
review_rules: Citation IDs must belong to the admitted set.
SDK publication must not establish adoption, maturity or team execution quality.
README brevity must not establish pre-traction or immature product status.
No unstated business category, founder, competitor or feature from model memory.
Outbound links do not establish fetched target contents.
Missing metrics are unknown, not negative outcomes.
Distinguish hypothetical reasoning from established facts.
evaluation_limits: One previously inspected source, not a holdout.
No paired baseline rerun and no causal attribution.
Reviewer-supplied judgments, not automatic entailment or independent human gold.
No statistical accuracy or investment-return metric.
